acceptance_predicates.description: A clean disposable environment runs asb tui install with the validated shim and then launches bare asb tui.
Symlink, traversal, non-regular-file, and out-of-root tool fixtures are rejected before mutation.
Missing development authentication, signatures, and key management remain warnings and do not block local/mock setup.
Only tools within the approved development root and matching expected identity are executed.
Receipts and diagnostics contain no credentials, raw responses, or private host paths.

definition_of_done: Focused shim security and installed-command tests pass.
Exact installed asb tui journey is recorded at current TUI main.
Independent review, AWQ, formal/source, privacy, and hosted state checks pass.

inputs.description: Explicit disposable cargo/rustup development tool root.
